RustDesk 1.5.3 corresponding source
==================================

This archive contains the official RustDesk 1.5.3 source archive and the exact
hbb_common submodule revision referenced by that release:

- rustdesk-1.5.3-source.zip: https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/tree/1.5.3
- hbb_common-fae47e024dd83cef6aaecde0aa7d11731df11649.zip: pinned Git submodule
  revision fae47e024dd83cef6aaecde0aa7d11731df11649
- AGPL-3.0.txt: license text

To reconstruct the checkout, extract rustdesk-1.5.3-source.zip, then extract the
hbb_common archive into rustdesk-1.5.3/libs/hbb_common (replace the empty
submodule placeholder). The original released Windows binary is unmodified.
